title: Parkio Daily for August 13, 2026
teaser: Fantasmic moves 30 minutes earlier starting Aug 23; China pavilion work closes section at EPCOT; Yzma joins Oogie Boogie Bash character lineup.

breaking.title: Fantasmic showtime moves earlier starting August 23
breaking.body: Hollywood Studios shifts both Fantasmic performances forward by 30 minutes beginning August 23. The change affects all nights with scheduled shows.

parkioInsight.text: The earlier window usually lets guests exit before the peak parking lot rush. Worth planning dinner reservations around the first show if you want to beat tram lines.

breaking.title: Section of China pavilion already closed again at EPCOT
breaking.body: Days after reopening from refurbishment, part of the China pavilion went dark overnight. Rolling planters now block guest access to the affected area.

parkioInsight.text: The pavilion's shopping and dining remain open, but expect detours through World Showcase. Reroute your loop if you're heading toward Norway or Germany to save steps.

bignews.title: Tokyo Disneyland names new Tomorrowland attractions
bignews.body: Space Mountain Earthrise and Sugar Rush: Sweet Rescue are the official names for Tokyo's two upcoming Tomorrowland attractions, part of a redesigned land opening in 2027.

parkioInsight.text: If you're planning a Tokyo trip for 2027, the new Tomorrowland will likely draw heavy crowds at debut. Visiting in shoulder months after opening tends to offer better access.

bignews.title: Yzma joins Oogie Boogie Bash character lineup
bignews.body: The villain from Emperor's New Groove will appear at this year's Oogie Boogie Bash at California Adventure, joining the Halloween party's character roster.

parkioInsight.text: Rare character meets typically draw lines early in the party. Heading to Yzma's location right after entry usually saves 20-plus minutes of queuing.

bignews.title: PizzeRizzo electrical work permit filed at Hollywood Studios
bignews.body: Imagineering contracted audiovisual vendor Solotech for electrical work inside the shuttered PizzeRizzo building, part of the ongoing Monstropolis conversion.

parkioInsight.text: Construction noise near Grand Avenue tends to spike mid-morning. If you're dining at Baseline Tap House or PizzeRizzo's neighbors, lunch or late afternoon visits are usually quieter.

topstories.title: Halloween food and décor arrive at Disney Springs
topstories.body: Fall-themed treats, entertainment, and seasonal décor run August 11 through November 9. Jock Lindsey's Hangar Bar returns with its Halloween overlay and new menu items through the same period.

parkioInsight.text: Jock Lindsey's Halloween menu items often sell out by late evening on weekends. Arriving before 5pm on weekdays typically ensures full availability.

topstories.title: D23 Expo previews S.E.A. presence and Imagineering merch
topstories.body: The Society of Explorers and Adventurers will appear in the Imagineering Pavilion at D23, August 14-16. Mickey's of Glendale returns with exclusive Walt Disney Imagineering merchandise.

parkioInsight.text: D23-exclusive merch at Mickey's of Glendale tends to move fast on opening day. Attendees who line up before the show floor opens usually have the widest selection.

topstories.title: Orlando airport issues travel warning for next 48 hours
topstories.body: Orlando International Airport alerted travelers to potential disruptions over the next two days. Guests flying to Disney World should confirm flight status before heading to MCO.

parkioInsight.text: Weather delays at MCO often cascade into evening. If you're arriving today or tomorrow, building an extra hour into your park plans may help avoid missed Lightning Lane windows.

topstories.title: Nightmare Before Christmas collection launches at Bath & Body Works
topstories.body: Disney and Bath & Body Works released a new collaboration featuring two fragrances inspired by characters from Tim Burton's Nightmare Before Christmas.

parkioInsight.text: Limited-run Disney collaborations at Bath & Body Works often see stock shortages within a week. Ordering online early or visiting a store today tends to guarantee availability.

topstories.title: Disney Dogs pajama set now at Disneyland Resort
topstories.body: A new adult pajama set featuring Disney dog characters is available at Disneyland merchandise locations for $64.99.

parkioInsight.text: Character apparel in popular sizes usually depletes by mid-afternoon at flagship shops. Stopping at Emporium or World of Disney before 11am often ensures your size is in stock.

topstories.title: Animal Kingdom Lodge ear headband added to resort collection
topstories.body: A new Minnie ear headband matching the Animal Kingdom Lodge collection arrived at Zawadi Marketplace, priced at $36.99.

parkioInsight.text: Resort-exclusive ears often restock slowly. If you're staying at Animal Kingdom Lodge, grabbing them on your first day tends to beat sellout risk.

icymi.title: Warrior Games returning to ESPN Wide World of Sports in 2027
icymi.body: The annual adaptive sports competition for wounded, ill, and injured service members will return to Walt Disney World in August 2027.

icymi.title: Halloween food guide published for Disneyland Resort
icymi.body: Disney released a preview of limited-time Halloween eats available at Disneyland Resort from August 21 through October 31.

icymi.title: Tokyo Disney Resort unveils Halloween 2026 merchandise
icymi.body: The resort shared its Halloween merchandise lineup for the 2026 season, which begins September 15. Collections feature ghosts, pumpkins, and seasonal designs.

spotlight.title: Mickey's Not-So-Scary Halloween Party adds new food and characters
spotlight.body: Magic Kingdom's Halloween party introduces updated menu items and character appearances for the 2026 season. The event runs select nights through October 31.

parkioInsight.text: Tuesday and Sunday party nights usually see lighter crowds than Fridays. Booking early-week dates often means shorter treat trail waits and better parade viewing spots.
